title: Unrolled networks are infeasible, fragile and lack closure

statements.text: Unrolling a brain-sized recurrent network over the hundreds of milliseconds of workspace dynamics may need supra-astronomical resources, so recurrence is a practical requirement. Feedforward equivalents match only when reset to identical conditions, diverge when intervened on, cannot repair themselves, and lack functional closure across moments of experience.

sources.quote: recurrent neural networks (RNNs) may be a practical requirement, as supra-astronomical resources may be necessary for unrolling an RNN into a functionally equivalent feedforward neural network (FNN)
These feedforward "zombie" systems tend to diverge from the functionalities of their recurrent counterparts when intervened upon and will be unable to repair their structure when modified.
